# graphiant_lan_segment (Resource)

A global LAN segment. There is no update endpoint, so every field is force-new.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graphiant_lan_segment" "corp" {
  name        = "corp-lan"
  description = "Corporate LAN segment"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)

### Read-Only

- `associated_interfaces` (Number)
- `edge_references` (Number)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `site_list_references` (Number)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import graphiant_lan_segment.corp <lan_segment_id>
```
